verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents CLI exit codes for scripts and CI/CD systems, plus an Automation API that runs the Pulumi engine as an SDK without the CLI. It also ships VCS integrations and PR checks, and a community user confirms running Pulumi in the CI/CD pipeline of all their microservices. Missing for 10: explicit documentation in the pack of non-interactive flags and CI token/auth setup for headless runs.
